confidence_notes: Holistic July estimate for a Rajasthan heritage-tourism city. Local meals are more predictable; accommodation varies widely across guesthouses and heritage properties. Cocktails and wine are estimated from the local beer price relationship and are less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on prices in mid-sized Indian tourist cities, with Jaipur and Udaipur as broad Rajasthan comparables; Jodhpur’s July heat and monsoon season may soften demand.
